description: Create house.electronics_catalogue, the warranty and serial-number listing.
rationale: This view exists to be in the way. It reads house.electronics.model, which 0098 widens -- and PostgreSQL refuses ALTER COLUMN TYPE outright while a view reads the column, whatever the change costs. That is the drop-and-recreate stack pg_laswell rebuilds for you.

intents.name: electronics_catalogue
intents.comment: Electronics with model, serial number and warranty date, for an insurance claim.
intents.definition: SELECT e.item_id, i.name, e.kind, e.model, e.serial_number, e.power_watts, e.warranty_until, i.purchase_date, i.purchase_price FROM house.electronics AS e JOIN house.item AS i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
